subject: Kathakali (Dance)
notes: Schools offer one style. Theory (30 marks, 2 hours) has no unit-wise split; practical is 70 marks.
Students are presumed to have preliminary training in the style.

chapters.name: Terms
topics: Nritta, nritya, natya, tandava, lasya, lokadharmi, natyadharmi; anga, upanga, pratyanga; abhinaya with hasta, mukhaja and netra abhinaya; sangeeta, tala, laya; rasa and bhava

chapters.name: Kathakali Technical Terminology
topics: Mudiyettu, theyyam, koodiyattam, ramanattam, krishnattam, ottanthullal, kalarippayattu; hastas; kalasam, ilakiyattam, cholliyattam; keli, todayam, purappadu, melapada; chutti, pachcha, kathi, thaadi, kari, minukku; notation of talas

chapters.name: Kathakali Costume, Make-up and Music
topics: Costumes and make-up; vocal and percussion music

chapters.name: Kalasams
topics: Vattamvechu, iratti, atakkam, thonkaaram, idakkalasam, eduthu kalasam, naalaaratti, sthreevesha kalasam, saaree dance, kummi

chapters.name: Padams
topics: Subhadraharanam (Sree Krishna), Dakshayaagam (Shiva, Sathi), Uttaraswayamvaram (Uttara); reciting kalasams with rhythm
